card.name: Opening quote before a spoken command
card.fires_on: Quote marks or commas right after 'say', 'said to' or an address word, where a spoken order or statement is about to begin. Also quote marks after 'e.g.,' before example commands.

modes.label: Quote opening speech
modes.description: An opening quote mark or comma just before someone's spoken order or remark.

modes.label: Example commands
modes.description: Quote mark or punctuation introducing sample instructions given to a patient.

modes.label: Direct address
modes.description: A comma after a title or name, before an order is given.
